name: skillgap-ai
description: SkillGap AI - Resume vs Job Description Matcher

scripts.predev: lsof -ti:5001,3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo '🧹 Ports cleared'
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "PORT=5001 npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix frontend
